orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
CLR No. 50 of 2019 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Rajat Mittal, Advocate for 
the revisionist. 
Issue notices to the respondents 
returnable at an early date. 
In addition to normal mode of service, 
revisionist is permitted to serve respondents 
personally through their counsel appearing 
before the learned trial Court. 
List this matter on 20.05.2019. 
In the meantime, it is provided that in 
case application is moved on behalf of the 
revisionist for adjournment, the learned 
Court below shall consider the application 
for grant of adjournment till 20.05.2019 
only. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
Arpan 30.04.2019
